arxiv-2001-08399.title: An Android Application Risk Evaluation Framework Based on Minimum Permission Set Identification Journal: Journal of Systems and Software
arxiv-2001-08399.creator: Jianmao Xiao, Shizhan Chen, Qiang He, Zhiyong Feng, Xiao Xue
arxiv-2001-08399.description: Abstract Android utilizes a security mechanism that requires apps to request permission for accessing sensitive user data, e.g., contacts and SMSs, or certain system features, e.g., camera and Internet access. However, Android apps tend to be overprivileged, i.e., they often request more permissions than necessary. This raises the security problem of overprivilege.

arxiv-2012-00791.title: Structure and Internal Kinematics of Nine Inner Milky Way Globular Clusters Based on observations made with the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope, obtained at the Space Telescope Science Institute, which is operated by the Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy, Inc., under NASA contrac
arxiv-2012-00791.creator: Roger E. Cohen, Andrea Bellini, Mattia Libralato, Matteo Correnti, Thomas M. Brown, Jason S. Kalirai
arxiv-2012-00791.description: Abstract This study constitutes part of a larger effort aimed at better characterizing the Galactic globular clusters (GGCs) located towards the inner Milky Way bulge and disk. Here, we focus on internal kinematics of nine GGCs, obtained from space-based imaging over time baselines of > > 9 years.

arxiv-2102-03598.title: Cwebs beyond three loops in multiparton amplitudes
arxiv-2102-03598.creator: Neelima Agarwal, Lorenzo Magnea, Sourav Pal, Anurag Tripathi
arxiv-2102-03598.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Neelima Agarwal, Lorenzo Magnea, Sourav Pal, Anurag Tripathi. Correlators of Wilson-line operators in non-abelian gauge theories are known to exponentiate, and their logarithms can be organised in terms of collections of Feynman diagrams called webs . In Agarwal:2020nyc we introduced the concept of Cweb , or correlator web , which is a set of skeleton diagrams built with connected gluon correlators, and we computed the mixing matrices for all Cwebs connecting four or five Wilson lines at four loops.

arxiv-2402-13598.title: User-LLM : Efficient LLM Contextualization with User Embeddings
arxiv-2402-13598.creator: Lin Ning, Luyang Liu \corresponding, Jiaxing Wu, Neo Wu, Devora Berlowitz, Sushant Prakash, Bradley Green, Shawn O’Banion, Jun Xie
arxiv-2402-13598.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across various domains, but effectively incorporating complex and potentially noisy user timeline data into LLMs remains a challenge. Current approaches often involve translating user timelines into text descriptions before feeding them to LLMs, which can be inefficient and may not fully capture the nuances of user behavior.

arxiv-2409-18387.title: Simpler Gradient Methods for Blind Super-Resolution with Lower Iteration Complexity
arxiv-2409-18387.creator: Jinsheng Li, Wei Cui, Xu Zhang
arxiv-2409-18387.description: Abstract We study the problem of blind super-resolution, which can be formulated as a low-rank matrix recovery problem via vectorized Hankel lift (VHL). The previous gradient descent method based on VHL named PGD-VHL relies on additional regularization such as the projection and balancing penalty, exhibiting a suboptimal iteration complexity.

arxiv-2504-02933.creator: Guillermo Parra-Martínez, Daniel Muñoz-Segovia, Héctor Ochoa, Jose Angel Silva-Guillén
arxiv-2504-02933.description: Abstract Transport and local spectroscopy measurements have revealed that monolayers of tungsten ditelluride ( 1 ​ T ′ 1T^{\prime} -WTe 2 ) display a quantum spin Hall effect and an excitonic gap at neutrality, besides becoming superconducting at low electron concentrations.

arxiv-2504-05815.title: Parasite: A Steganography-based Backdoor Attack Framework for Diffusion Models
arxiv-2504-05815.creator: Jiahao Chen, Yu Pan, Yi Du, Chunkai Wu, Lin Wang
arxiv-2504-05815.description: Abstract Recently, the diffusion model has gained significant attention as one of the most successful image generation models, which can generate high-quality images by iteratively sampling noise. However, recent studies have shown that diffusion models are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, allowing attackers to enter input data containing triggers to activate the backdoor and generate their desired output.

arxiv-2505-06200.title: Robust Decision-Making in Finite-Population Games
arxiv-2505-06200.creator: Shinkyu Park, Lucas C. D. Bezerra
arxiv-2505-06200.description: Abstract We study the robustness of an agent decision-making model in finite-population games, with a particular focus on the Kullback-Leibler Divergence Regularized Learning (KLD-RL) model. Specifically, we examine how the model’s parameters influence the impact of various sources of noise and modeling inaccuracies—factors commonly encountered in engineering applications of population games—on agents’ decision-making.

arxiv-2506-22678.title: 3D Shape Generation: A Survey
arxiv-2506-22678.creator: Nicolas Caytuiro, Ivan Sipiran
arxiv-2506-22678.description: Abstract Recent advances in deep learning have significantly transformed the field of 3D shape generation, enabling the synthesis of complex, diverse, and semantically meaningful 3D objects. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of the art in 3D shape generation, organizing the discussion around three core components: shape representations, generative modeling approaches, and evaluation protocols.

arxiv-2507-12438.title: Heisenberg limited multiple eigenvalue estimation via off-the-grid compressed sensing
arxiv-2507-12438.creator: Davide Castaldo, Stefano Corni
arxiv-2507-12438.description: Abstract Quantum phase estimation is the flagship algorithm for quantum simulation on fault-tolerant quantum computers. We demonstrate that an off-grid compressed sensing protocol, combined with a state-of-the-art signal classification method, enables the simultaneous estimation of multiple eigenvalues of a unitary matrix using the Hadamard test while sampling only a few percent of the full autocorrelation function.

arxiv-2508-00023.title: Weak Values as Geometric Lenses: Deformations of Hilbert Space and the Emergence of superoscillations
arxiv-2508-00023.creator: Mirco A. Mannucci
arxiv-2508-00023.description: Abstract The formalism of weak measurement in quantum mechanics has revealed profound connections between measurement theory, quantum foundations, and signal processing. In this paper, we develop a pointer-free derivation of superoscillations, demonstrating that they are a natural and necessary consequence of the geometric structure underlying weak values.

pmc-12609946.title: Symmetry After Breast Reconstruction Surgery: A Comparison of Immediate vs. Delayed-Immediate Breast Reconstruction Using Smartphone-Based 3D Surface Imaging
pmc-12609946.creator: Robin Hartmann, Nikolas Chrobot, Christian Festbaum, Michael Alfertshofer, Katharina Theresa Obermeier, Wenko Smolka, Tobias Ettl, Lukas Prantl, Vanessa Brébant, Salvatore Giordano

pmc-12623515.description: IntroductionPeople with advanced Parkinson’s disease (aPD) frequently experience unpredictable “Off” time and debilitating motor fluctuations. Foslevodopa/foscarbidopa (LDp/CDp), a levodopa/carbidopa (LD/CD) prodrug, is delivered as a 24-h continuous subcutaneous infusion. This post hoc analysis evaluated the efficacy of LDp/CDp in achieving consistent motor symptom control and stable motor states in people with aPD.

pmc-13036095.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026).
